project.name: osgi/runtime/junit-testkit
project.description: The test-only tag annotations a test wears out-of-container to classify itself for surefire selection: @Osgi/@OsgiWorld (the OSGi-world marker) and @Pipeline (marks a *Test that exercises a runtime pipeline). The runtime-playable machinery (the two framework envelopes, the SCR diagnostic, the neutral launcher core) moved to osgi/runtime/scenario-engine when JUnit/jGiven became runtime-scope. Kept an attachable test bundle (a bundle is a superset of a plain jar) so a -test fixture can attach to it; the shared logback-test.xml still ships in this jar.
